result.basic: W-2 Ask a question and get a fast, streamed, correct answer
result.observed_result: Signed in as the Free test account, opened a new chat and asked "What is 17 × 19? Give the number, then show the calculation." The reply was "323" followed by "17 × 19 = 17 × (20 − 1) = 340 − 17 = 323". That is correct, with a valid calculation. The title was set automatically. After a reload the conversation was identical. A longer five-method answer streamed and finished correctly. Pressing Stop on a 1200-word essay showed "Response stopped." with a Try again button, kept the partial text, and the state survived a reload. Offline showed an Offline pill and "You are offline. Your draft is saved here and can be sent after you reconnect." After reconnecting, the draft sent and returned a correct "667". Dark and light at 1280 and 390 looked fine, with nothing overlapping or cut off. It is partial because of small defects: a "Free limit reached" banner appeared while chatting still worked and was clipped behind the composer, an old terms toast overlapped the header, and the first message sat in the middle of an empty screen. The run video was not saved.
result.first_words_ms: 1125 ms, from the server log line llm_ttft_observed for my conversation 1ce43444 (turn total 1334 ms). By stopwatch the whole short answer was already painted at my first screenshot, about 7 s after Enter including tool overhead.
result.stream_and_finish: The short answer finished almost instantly. The five-method answer streamed in visible increments, with the Stop button present while it ran. A raw "(9 \times 17 =" flashed briefly mid-stream and then rendered as proper maths. The final text was complete and correct.
result.recovery_and_sync: Reload after the first answer kept the conversation. Stop halfway left a "Response stopped / Try again" notice and the partial text, which survived a reload. Offline: a clear banner and the draft was kept. Online: Enter sent it and the answer came back (667). The conversation appears in Recents under Today. One small lag: about 3 s after going back online, the "You are offline" banner was still showing above the composer, though the Offline pill was gone (12-online.png).
result.leader_comparison: Compared with ChatGPT and Claude from my own knowledge. Streaming, Stop with a retry, offline draft handling and sidebar titling match them. Two things are slightly worse. A new chat's first message sits mid-screen under a large empty area, where the leaders place it at the top. A "Free limit reached" banner showed while chatting still worked.
result.light_dark_and_size: Dark at 1280 (16-dark-1280.png) and dark at 390 (17-dark-390.png) were fine. Light at 1280 (03/06/13) and light at 390 (14-phone-light.png) were fine. No overlap or cut-off, except the clipped banner and the toast listed in the problems.
result.video_path: Not saved. video-start printed no error, but no run.webm was written to the evidence folder.

A typed turn in the voice composer was answered "11" in about 2 s and kept after reload. The spoken path could not be verified. With the fake microphone, voice mode never produced a transcript or a reply in 40+ s. Dictation returned Mongolian and Arabic gibberish instead of "What is five plus six?". With microphone access denied, dictation shows a clear message and Try again, but Start voice mode shows nothing at all. No session was created and no audio was sent.
